scripts.preview: alias=$(git branch --show-current | tr A-Z a-z | tr -c 'a-z0-9\n' - | cut -c1-40 | sed 's/^[^a-z]*//; s/-*$//') && test -n "$alias" || { echo 'preview needs a checked-out branch' >&2; exit 1; } && pnpm build && wrangler versions upload --preview-alias "$alias"
scripts.deploy: test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main || { echo 'deploy runs from main only' >&2; exit 1; } && pnpm build && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: test -n "$DOCS_URL" || { echo "check needs DOCS_URL, the deployed site to check" >&2; exit 1; } && playwright install chromium && playwright test
